correctness.rationale: Complete all-graph proof: favorite apex color removes every apex-outgoing envy edge; a palette reduction gives a stable colouring on the rest. For lower bound, lift an obstructing \(k-1\)-colour profile by adding a last-ranked color on original vertices and top-ranked color on the apex; either the apex takes it and exposes an obstructed G-coloring, or a G vertex takes it and creates a mutual-envy 2-cycle, or nobody takes it and restriction to G is again obstructed. Palette universality is monotone, so a \(k\)-palette obstruction excludes smaller q; the boundary k=1 and induction over t are handled explicitly. The supplementary finite verifier returned VERIFY_OK.
